k \times (k + 1 + \text{pos}) & \text{if } n = T(k - 1) + \text{pos}, \text{ where } 0 \leq \text{pos} < k \\
a(n - 1) + k & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

Where:
- $ k $ is the group number such that $ T(k - 1) \leq n < T(k) $
- $ \text{pos} = n - T(k - 1) $

---

### **Conclusion**
The recursive formula for the sequence is based on identifying the group $ k $ and the position within the group. While the formula is not as simple as a direct recurrence like $ a(n) = a(n - 1) + c $, it accurately captures the structure of the sequence as described.
